---
title: MultiInputKeyResolver
---

## Overview

`MultiInputKeyResolver` provides free functions used by `TransformsV2Properties_Widget`
to configure and execute single-step binary transforms (Option A).

## API

- `getMultiInputTransformInfo(transform_name)` — reads `is_multi_input` and
  `individual_input_types` from `ElementRegistry`.
- `getSecondaryContainerType(primary_container, individual_input_types)` — resolves
  which container type the second-input combo should list.
- `resolveOrderedBinaryInputKeys(...)` — maps focused primary + user-selected
  secondary keys into `(input_key, additional_input_keys[0])` registry order.

## Related UI

See [Schema-Driven Forms](../../../ui/schema_driven_forms.qmd#multi-input-transforms-option-a)
for Option A limitations and widget behavior.
